Description
Our client is a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) for sterile injectables in the Basel region. The site fills vials and prefilled syringes for biotech and pharma customers from Europe and the United States and employs around 420 people.

Following a Swissmedic inspection with several major observations, and ahead of a pre-approval inspection by the FDA planned for mid-2027, the client needs an experienced interim Head of Quality. The current Head of Quality has left the company; the permanent successor is expected to start in summer 2027.

Your tasks
- Lead Quality Assurance and Quality Control with 38 employees
- Act as Responsible Person (Fachtechnisch verantwortliche Person) towards Swissmedic and take over batch certification
- Drive the remediation plan after the Swissmedic inspection, including the contamination control strategy under EU GMP Annex 1
- Reduce the backlog of deviations and CAPAs and strengthen root cause analysis
- Prepare the site for the FDA pre-approval inspection (inspection readiness, mock inspections, data integrity review)
- Represent Quality in customer audits and quality agreements
- Report to the site head and the quality council of the group

Your profile
- Pharmacist or natural scientist with a qualification as Qualified Person or Responsible Person
- 10+ years in quality assurance for sterile manufacturing, of which at least 5 years as Head of QA, Head of Quality or QP
- Proven experience with FDA and Swissmedic or EU inspections and with remediation after inspection findings
- Solid knowledge of Annex 1, data integrity and electronic QMS (e.g. Veeva Vault, TrackWise)
- Fluent English; German is an advantage

Conditions
- Start: November 2026, duration 9 months with an option to extend
- On site in the Basel region four days per week, one day remote
- Day rate: CHF 1,250, expenses paid separately
- Freelance contract with Birsfeld Pharma Consulting AG
